relationships.subject: dorsal root ganglion electrical stimulation
relationships.evidence_quote: Electrical stimulation (ES) at the DRG has been shown to effectively promote fracture healing by increasing calcitonin gene related peptide (CGRP) expression in both DRG and the fracture callus

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Upregulation of CGRP contributes to type-H vessel formation, a biological event coupling angiogenesis and osteogenesis, thereby enhancing osteoporotic fracture healing

relationships.subject: sensory denervation
relationships.evidence_quote: Altogether, these findings suggest that denervation of the fracture site, especially sensory denervation, compromises fracture healing.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF promotes osteoblast migration and increases integrin β1 expression, a protein involved in cell adhesion and migration, through TrkB receptor activation of ERK1/2 and AKT signaling pathways

key_findings: Review: sensory nerve activation, via DRG electrical stimulation and CGRP, enhances fracture healing.
Sensory and sympathetic denervation impair callus quality and mechanical strength.
